name: token-notifier
description: Show Codex rollout token usage and locally calculated cost after each answer.

interface.shortDescription: Show rollout token usage and calculated cost after each Codex answer
interface.longDescription: A Windows 10/11 Codex plugin that reads Codex rollout usage records, applies local model pricing, and displays configurable token, cost, and calculated metrics in native Windows notifications after each completed answer.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest Codex usage summary.
